preconditions.description: The number of horses n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of enemy pairs m must be between 0 and 3 times the number of horses n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in enemies)
preconditions.description: Each enemy pair must consist of distinct horses within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or len(stdout) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' indicating no valid split or a string of length n containing only '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: any((stdout[i] == '0' and sum(1 for j in enemies if j[0] == i + 1 and stdout[j[1] - 1] == '0') <= 1) or (stdout[i] == '1' and sum(1 for j in enemies if j[0] == i + 1 and stdout[j[1] - 1] == '1') <= 1) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each horse must have at most one enemy in its party.
